company.shortDescription: Andy AI provides AI-driven, clinically verified OASIS scribing, quality checks, and coding to simplify healthcare documentation.
company.description: Andy AI provides AI-powered healthcare documentation solutions designed to assist medical professionals in clinical workflows. The platform offers OASIS scribing, quality assurance, and coding services to streamline patient record management and ensure accuracy. It integrates artificial intelligence with clinical oversight, where all outputs are reviewed by healthcare experts to maintain compliance and correctness. The system supports efficient documentation for healthcare providers, reducing administrative workload while preserving the integrity of patient information. It also facilitates structured data capture, enabling better reporting and analytics for care management. Its services are oriented toward improving operational efficiency in clinical settings through automated yet clinically verified processes.
